summary: Optional agent-card mailbox fault reads retain their own wall backstop inside longer roster and request budgets. A stalled fault query preserves the last known fault or reports unknown without discarding current card fields. Roster reconciliation regressions now use canonical qualified subjects and the registered work lease field.

rules.detail: No authority or membership policy change.

compatibility.detail: No wire change. Enclosing deadlines may shorten but cannot extend optional fault reads.
